cryptoPage.adviceHeading: Trading Wisdom from the Mentix Team
cryptoPage.adviceSubheading: These principles are battle-tested by professional traders. Apply them consistently to improve your edge.
cryptoPage.tip1Title: Never Risk More Than 2% Per Trade
cryptoPage.tip1Desc: Professional traders protect their capital first. Limit each trade to 1-2% of your total portfolio to survive drawdowns and stay in the game long-term.
cryptoPage.tip2Title: Trade the Structure, Not the News
cryptoPage.tip2Desc: News creates noise. Focus on market structure, key levels, and order flow. Let price action tell you the story - the chart never lies.
cryptoPage.tip3Title: Master Your Emotions Before the Market
cryptoPage.tip3Desc: FOMO and fear are your biggest enemies. Develop a trading plan and follow it religiously. Journal every trade and review your psychology weekly.
cryptoPage.tip4Desc: Always check the higher timeframe for bias, then zoom into the lower timeframe for entries. The weekly sets the trend, the daily confirms, and the 4H/1H provides entries.
cryptoPage.tip5Desc: Do not be greedy. Take partial profits at key levels (TP1, TP2, TP3) and move your stop to breakeven. This secures gains while letting winners run.
cryptoPage.tip6Desc: Smart money hunts liquidity. Look for equal highs/lows, stop hunts, and liquidity sweeps before entering. Trade with the smart money, not against it.
cryptoPage.disclaimerText: This content is for educational and informational purposes only and should not be considered financial advice. Cryptocurrency trading involves significant risk, and you could lose your entire investment. Always do your own research (DYOR) and consult with a qualified financial advisor before making any investment decisions. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
